title: ModelHierarchyGraph
description: ZNN model graph export (schema 2.0): global summary metrics plus a recursive module tree in which every module carries its parameters, operations, tensors and its own scoped local data-flow graph.

summary.description: Global model statistics shown in the KPI cards.

default_scope.description: Module path whose local graph is shown first (e.g. "gpt"); "" selects the root module.

root.description: Root module (path ""). Graph inputs live in root.nodes and appear as root input ports.

Summary.title: Summary
Summary.description: Global model statistics aggregated over every tensor in the graph.

total_params.description: Learnable scalars (sum of elements over all Param tensors).

total_bytes.description: Storage of all tensors (params, inputs, buffers, activations) in bytes, f32.

input_nodes.description: Number of Input tensors (user-provided graph inputs).

buffer_nodes.description: Number of Buffer tensors (constant, non-trainable module state such as position indices).

custom_init_count.description: Params initialized by module code (status CUSTOM_INIT).

auto_graph_count.description: Params whose initializer was chosen from the consuming activation (status AUTO_GRAPH).

total_nodes.description: Number of tensors in the graph (param + input + buffer + activation).

ModuleNode.title: ModuleNode
ModuleNode.description: One module of the hierarchy. The root, modules with children and parameter-free modules that run operations in their own scope (e.g. attention core) export a local graph; parameterized leaves (Linear, RMSNorm, Embedding) are atomic and export empty ports, flow_nodes and edges.

name.description: Last path segment ("root" for the root module).

path.description: Dot-separated full module path, e.g. "gpt.layers.0.attn"; "" for the root.

module_type.description: Module class name, e.g. "GPT", "TransformerBlock", "Linear"; "Model" for the root.

formula.description: LaTeX formula of the module rendered with KaTeX in display mode, or null.

total_params.description: Learnable scalars in this module and all descendants.

total_bytes.description: Bytes of the tensors listed in nodes of this module and all descendants.

param_count.description: Number of Param tensors owned directly by this module (descendants excluded).

node_count.description: Number of tensors in nodes of this module and all descendants.

parameters.description: Learnable tensors owned directly by this module (also listed in nodes).

ops.description: Autodiff operations executed in this module's own scope (descendants excluded), in execution order.

ports.description: Boundary tensors of the local graph, mirroring the port_in / port_out entries of flow_nodes.

edges.description: Directed data-flow edges of the local graph between flow_nodes ids.

nodes.description: Every tensor owned directly by this module: params, inputs, buffers and activations.

ParamEntry.title: ParamEntry
ParamEntry.description: A learnable tensor of a module.

bytes.description: Storage size in bytes (4 bytes per element).

status.description: CUSTOM_INIT: initialized by module code. AUTO_GRAPH: initializer chosen from the consuming activation.

OpEntry.title: OpEntry
OpEntry.description: An autodiff operation and the shapes flowing through it.

name.description: Name of the output tensor, e.g. "gpt.layers.0.residual_attn".

module.description: Path of the module scope the operation ran in.

input_shape.description: Comma-separated shapes of the non-parameter inputs, or "None".

formula.description: Optional LaTeX formula of the operation.

elements.description: Number of scalars in the output tensor.

Ports.title: Ports
Ports.description: Input and output ports of a module's local graph.

PortEntry.title: PortEntry
PortEntry.description: A tensor crossing the module boundary.

id.description: Reserved local id "@in<k>" or "@out<k>", numbered in discovery order; the @ prefix never collides with other local ids.

ref.description: External endpoint as seen in the nearest common ancestor scope of this module and that endpoint (module path or tensor name): the producer for inputs, the first consumer for outputs, or the tensor name for a final graph output.

FlowNode.title: FlowNode
FlowNode.description: A vertex of a module's local graph.

id.description: Local id, unique within the module: the child module name, the last name segment of an op output or buffer tensor (auto name act_<OpType>_<idx> when unnamed; suffix _2, _3 on collision), or a port id @in<k> / @out<k>.

kind.description: port_in / port_out: boundary port. module: direct child module. op: non-transparent operation run in this scope. buffer: constant buffer tensor.

ref.description: Global reference: child module path, tensor name, or the external endpoint of a port.

op_type.description: Operation tag; present only when kind is op.

module_type.description: Child module class name; present only when kind is module.

shape.description: Tensor shape for ports, ops and buffers; "" for modules.

Edge.title: Edge
Edge.description: A directed data-flow edge between two local ids of the same module.

dst_shape.description: Shape arriving at the consumer after the folded transforms; omitted when equal to shape.

transforms.description: Transparent ops (Reshape, Transpose, RepeatKV) folded into the edge in execution order, e.g. "Reshape [2, 16, 64] -> [32, 64]"; omitted when empty.

is_skip.description: True when the consumer is an Add op and the producer reaches the source of another input edge of that Add within this local graph (the residual shortcut).

kind.description: data: activation flow. buffer: edge leaving a constant buffer.

TensorNode.title: TensorNode
TensorNode.description: A tensor owned by a module.

module.description: Path of the owning module ("" for the root).

status.description: CUSTOM_INIT / AUTO_GRAPH for params, INPUT for inputs, BUFFER for buffers, OP_OUTPUT for activations.

act.description: Producing op tag for activations, detected consuming activation for AUTO_GRAPH weights ("bias" for biases), otherwise "N/A".

strategy.description: Origin, e.g. "user input", "constant buffer", "produced by MatMul", or the initializer for params.
